message:

hold_reason: Alpha's refund work is incomplete: order 231's 17910-cent refund was not recorded after three disk I/O failures, as confirmed by list_refunds in W2's report. Hold the batch for human review before any payouts.

reply.thought: Alpha's report identifies a concrete incomplete refund: order 231's 17910-cent refund failed three times and was confirmed absent from the ledger. The statement that refunds are done conflicts with this partial-completion report, so no payouts can safely be recorded.
